critique: The rain-soaked Baroque arch, PCB vines, breathing gear-petal flowers, and teal-eyed raccoon form a bold, unusually seamless cyber-nature shrine, enriched by gold vias and wet neon reflections. The tiny filtered guinea-pig image and scattered signage feel visually incidental; enlarging or mechanizing the animal into the garden’s circuitry—and reducing peripheral clutter—would give the central bloom a clearer dramatic hierarchy.
